SELECT `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `School Type` = 'Continuation School'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT T1.School
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T1.Magnet = 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores st ON s.CDSCode = st.cds
ORDER BY st.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CDSCode
FROM frpm
WHERE (`Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 500

SELECT s.District
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AVG(t.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.County = 'Alameda'
  AND sc.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND s.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT T2.CharterNum
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND T2.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrWrite DESC

SELECT T2.FundingType
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T2.CDSCode
HAVING AVG(T1.AvgScrMath) > 400

SELECT T2.School, T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`County Name` = 'Monterey'
  AND T1.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
  AND T1.`School Type` = 'High Schools';

SELECT s.School, s.DOCType
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm f2
      JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  );

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS `Eligible Free Rate (K-12)`
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9

SELECT frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND schools.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson';

SELECT s.AdmEmail1
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(T2.NumTstTakr)
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.County = 'Fresno' AND strftime('%Y', T1.OpenDate) = '1980';

SELECT s.AvgScrWrite, sc.City
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School, f.`Enrollment (K-12)`
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = 31
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.sname, sc.MailStreet
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools AS T1 
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds 
WHERE T2.AvgScrRead + T2.AvgScrMath + T2.AvgScrWrite >= 1500 
  AND T1.MailCity = 'Lakeport';

WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson')

FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND T2.Charter = 0
  AND T1."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / T1."Enrollment (K-12)" < 0.18;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' AND CharterNum = '00D4'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Stanislaus'
  AND FundingType = 'Directly Funded'
  AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) BETWEEN '2000' AND '2005';

SELECT County
FROM schools
WHERE SOC = 11
  AND strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989'
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School,
       f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" * 100.0 / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode

SELECT GSserved
FROM schools
WHERE City = 'Adelanto'
GROUP BY GSserved
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.City, T2.School, T1.`Low Grade`
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.State = 'CA'
ORDER BY T2.Latitude ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(T2.City), COUNT(T2.CDSCode)
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
  AND T2.Magnet = 1
  AND T2.GSserved = 'K-8'
GROUP BY T2.City

SELECT T1.`District Code`,
       T2.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine'

SELECT AdmEmail1, AdmEmail2, AdmEmail3
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND District = 'San Bernardino City Unified'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', OpenDate) BETWEEN '2009' AND '2010'
  AND SOC = 62
  AND DOC = 54;

LIMIT 1;

FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT MAX(p.AnswerCount) AS AnswerCount
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id

FROM users u

FROM badges b

SELECT AVG(p.Score) AS AverageScore

SELECT users.DisplayName
FROM comments

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.LastEditorUserId = u.Id

FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM votes v

FROM users
WHERE users.Location LIKE '%New York%'
  AND users.Id IN (SELECT UserId FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Teachers')
  AND users.Id IN (SELECT UserId FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Supporter');

FROM users u
JOIN postHistory ph ON ph.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Views >= 1000

SELECT T1.Name
FROM badges AS T1
INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.Id
INNER JOIN comments AS T3 ON T3.UserId = T2.Id
GROUP BY T2.Id
ORDER BY COUNT(T3.Id) DESC
LIMIT 1

    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT PostHistoryTypeId) 
     FROM postHistory 
     WHERE PostId = 3720) AS PostHistoryTypeIds,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserId) 
     FROM comments 
     WHERE PostId = 3720

SELECT posts.Score, postLinks.LinkTypeId
FROM posts
JOIN postLinks ON posts.Id = postLinks.PostId
WHERE posts.Id = 395;

SELECT SUM(u.UpVotes) / COUNT(p.UserId) AS average_up_votes,
       SUM(u.Age) / COUNT(p.UserId) AS average_age
FROM users AS u
JOIN posts AS p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId

HAVING COUNT(p.UserId) > 10;

SELECT badges.Date
FROM badges
JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id
WHERE users.Location = 'Rochester, NY';

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Name = 'Teacher' THEN UserId END) * 100.0 / COUNT(UserId) AS percentage
FROM badges;

SELECT c.Text
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.CreaionDate = '2010-07-19 19:37:33';

SELECT DISTINCT u.Age
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId
WHERE u.Location = 'Vienna, Austria';

SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Sharpie';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes WHERE strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2010';

SELECT DISTINCT posts.Tags
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'John Salvatier';

FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky' OR users.DisplayName = 'Noah Snyder'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserId)
FROM badges
WHERE Name = 'Commentator'
  AND strftime('%Y', Date) = '2014';
SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM posts WHERE CreationDate BETWEEN '2010-07-21 00:00:00' AND '2012-07-21 23:59:59';

SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Location LIKE '%North Pole%'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', b.Date) AS INTEGER) = 2011;

SELECT u.DisplayName, u.WebsiteUrl
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.FavoriteCount > 150;

SELECT COUNT(postHistory.Id) AS PostHistoryCount,
       posts.LastEditDate
FROM posts
JOIN postHistory ON posts.Id = postHistory.PostId
WHERE posts.Title = 'What is the best introductory Bayesian statistics textbook?'
GROUP BY posts.Id, posts.LastEditDate;

SELECT users.LastAccessDate, users.Location
FROM badges
JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id
WHERE badges.Name = 'Outliers';

SELECT T1.PostId, T2.Name
FROM comments AS T1
INNER JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.UserId
WHERE T1.UserDisplayName = 'Samuel'
  AND strftime('%Y', T1.CreationDate) = '2013'
  AND strftime('%Y', T2.Date) = '2013';
SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM tags WHERE Count BETWEEN 5000 AND 7000;

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId
GROUP BY u.Id
ORDER BY COUNT(b.Name) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MIN(v.CreationDate) AS FirstVoteDate
FROM votes v
JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'chl';

SELECT COUNT(p.Id) AS num_posts
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Jay Stevens'
  AND strftime('%Y', p.CreaionDate) = '2010';

SELECT Id, Title
FROM posts
ORDER BY Score DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.ViewCount > 20000
  AND strftime('%Y', p.CreaionDate) = '2011';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE ViewCount > (SELECT AVG(ViewCount) FROM posts);

SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT Name
FROM badges
WHERE UserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'Emmett')
  AND Date = (SELECT MAX(Date) FROM badges WHERE UserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'Emmett'));

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_adult_users
FROM users
WHERE Age BETWEEN 19 AND 65
  AND UpVotes > 5000;

SELECT julianday(b.Date) - julianday(u.CreationDate) AS days_to_badge
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Zolomon';

SELECT c.Text, u.DisplayName
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
LEFT JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Analysing wind data with R'
ORDER BY c.CreationDate DESC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tags WHERE TagName = 'careers';

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM comments
   WHERE PostId = (SELECT Id FROM posts WHERE Title = 'Clustering 1D data')) AS CommentCount,
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM posts
   WHERE PostTypeId = 2
     AND ParentId = (SELECT Id FROM posts WHERE Title = 'Clustering 1D data')) AS AnswerCount;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN p.Score > 50 THEN 1 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM posts p
WHERE p.OwnerUserId = (
    SELECT u.Id
    FROM users u
    ORDER BY u.Reputation DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tags WHERE Id < 15 AND Count <= 20;

SELECT c.Text
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Title LIKE '%linear regression%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.UserId) 
FROM comments c 
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id 
WHERE c.Score = 0 AND u.Age = 40;

SELECT c.Text
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky';

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE c.Score BETWEEN 1 AND 5
  AND u.DownVotes = 0;

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN u.UpVotes = 0 THEN c.UserId END) * 100.0 / COUNT(c.UserId) AS percentage
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE c.Score BETWEEN 5 AND 10;

SELECT T1.CustomerID
FROM customers AS T1
JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM'
  AND T2.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
GROUP BY T1.CustomerID
ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM (
    SELECT c.CustomerID
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID
    HAVING SUM(y.Consumption) < 30000
);

SELECT c.Segment
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.CustomerID
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
  AND c.Currency = 'Euro'
  AND y.Date = '201310'
ORDER BY y.Consumption DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption)
FROM customers AS T1
INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T1.Segment = 'KAM' AND T2.Date = '201305'

SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT y.CustomerID)
     FROM yearmonth y
     JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
     WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM' AND y.Consumption > 46.73) * 100.0
    /
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID)
     FROM customers
     WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS percentage;
SELECT MAX(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE substr(Date, 1, 4) = '2012'

SELECT MAX(monthly_consumption) AS biggest_monthly_consumption
FROM (
    SELECT SUM(ym.Consumption) / 12.0 AS monthly_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
);

SELECT DISTINCT p.Description
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN transactions_1k t ON y.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
WHERE y.Date = '201309';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Country
FROM gasstations AS T1
INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID
WHERE strftime('%Y%m', T2.Date) = '201306'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID)
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  AND y.Consumption > 1000;

SELECT CustomerID
FROM transactions_1k
WHERE Date = '2012-08-25'
GROUP BY CustomerID
ORDER BY SUM(Price) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT g.Country
FROM gasstations g
JOIN transactions_1k t ON g.GasStationID = t.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'
ORDER BY t.Time ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.Segment
FROM customers c
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
ORDER BY t.Date ASC, t.Time ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.Country
FROM transactions_1k AS T1
JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID
WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-24' AND T1.Time = '12:42:00';

SELECT c.Currency
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE y.Date LIKE '%201306%' AND y.Consumption = 214582.17;

SELECT c.Currency
FROM customers c
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-24' AND t.Price = 548.4;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM customers AS c
JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'

SELECT SUM(t.Price) AS TotalSpent
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN yearmonth y ON t.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE t.CustomerID = 38508
  AND y.Date = '201201';

SELECT 
    t.CustomerID,
    SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS avg_price_per_item,
    c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY t.CustomerID, c.Currency
ORDER BY SUM(t.Price) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT height, player_name
FROM Player
ORDER BY height DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT preferred_foot
FROM Player_Attributes
ORDER BY potential ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
GROUP BY player_api_id
ORDER BY MAX(crossing) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Match M
JOIN Team T ON M.home_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
  AND (M.home_team_goal - M.away_team_goal) < 0
GROUP BY T.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  AND overall_rating = (
      SELECT MAX(overall_rating)
      FROM Player_Attributes
      WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
        AND overall_rating > (
            SELECT AVG(overall_rating)
            FROM Player_Attributes
            WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
        )
  );

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', TA.date) = '2012'
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing > (
      SELECT SUM(TA2.buildUpPlayPassing) / COUNT(T2.team_long_name)
      FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2
      JOIN Team AS T2 ON TA2.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
      WHERE strftime('%Y', TA2.date) = '2012'
        AND TA2.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT SUM(PA.long_shots) / COUNT(PA.player_fifa_api_id) AS average_long_shots
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_fifa_api_id = P.player_fifa_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_fifa_api_id = PA.player_fifa_api_id
WHERE P.height > 180
GROUP BY P.player_fifa_api_id
ORDER BY SUM(PA.heading_accuracy) * 1.0 / COUNT(PA.player_fifa_api_id) DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
  AND TA.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND TA.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  AND TA.chanceCreationPassing < (
      SELECT AVG(TA2.chanceCreationPassing)
      FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2
      WHERE TA2.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
        AND TA2.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
        AND TA2.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  )
ORDER BY TA.chanceCreationPassing DESC;
SELECT team_short_name FROM Team WHERE team_long_name = 'Queens Park Rangers';

SELECT DISTINCT pa.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Franco Zennaro';

SELECT PA.heading_accuracy
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Francois Affolter'
    AND PA.date = '2014-09-18 00:00:00';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS match_count
FROM Match
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id
WHERE League.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
  AND Match.season = '2015/2016';

SELECT PA.preferred_foot
FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
JOIN Player AS P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE P.birthday = (SELECT MAX(birthday) FROM Player)
ORDER BY PA.date DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT League.name
FROM League
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE Country.name = 'Netherlands';

SELECT AVG(Match.home_team_goal) AS average_home_team_goal
FROM Match
JOIN Country ON Match.country_id = Country.id
WHERE Country.name = 'Poland'
  AND Match.season = '2010/2011';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player WHERE strftime('%Y', birthday) = '1990';

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.overall_rating > 80
  AND strftime('%Y', pa.date) BETWEEN '2008' AND '2010';

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.preferred_foot = 'left';

SELECT ta.buildUpPlayPassingClass
FROM Team t
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_short_name = 'CLB';

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name
FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team AS T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayPassing > 70;

SELECT c.name
FROM League l
JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
WHERE l.name = 'Italy Serie A';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Match

FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(atom.atom_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
